added_claims.claim: Buying restructured Latin American sovereign debt (Brady bonds) after the 1980s debt crisis offered about 25% dollar yields and performed very well as the region boomed in the early 1990s: post-crisis restructured EM debt is a rich entry point.

added_claims.claim: India is Citrone's long-term growth favourite: decades of reform, a large market, English language and good rule of law make reforms hard to reverse, with key-person political risk around Modi.

added_claims.claim: After a bad year Discovery credited back management fees to investors who stayed instead of closing and relaunching to reset the high-water mark, and investors recovered losses and more in under two years: fee give-backs and refusal to reset are alignment signals when choosing hedge fund managers.

corrections.issue: Citrone says core inflation has fallen three months in a row year over year (and also month over month), not three monthly declines.
corrections.fix: Core inflation peaked in mid-2022: three straight year-over-year declines plus lower month-over-month readings, but it will not fall fast enough to let the Fed stop tightening; energy and food are the headline risks.
